page_title: EMP 1-3 LEC | Empoli v Lecce 11/01/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+5' Jacopo Fazzini (Empoli) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the left side of the target, but Wladimiro Falcone easily deals with the threat.
90+4' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Liberato Cacace (Empoli) takes it short.
90+2' Referee Daniele Chiffi signals that the goal stands after the VAR review and the Lecce players have a reason to celebrate!
90+2' Wait! The referee has now indicated he wants to check if the goal for Lecce can stand using VAR.
90+1' 1 - 3 Goal! Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) collects a pass and without hesitation fires an unstoppable shot into the top left corner.
90' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
88' Junior Sambia (Empoli) has the ability to send the ball deep into the penalty area from throw-ins and it can lead to very promising situations for his team.
85' Liberato Cacace (Empoli) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.
85' Sebastiano Esposito (Empoli) drives a shot towards the bottom right corner from inside the box, but Wladimiro Falcone leaps like a salmon and knocks the ball away.
84' Junior Sambia (Empoli) steps up and sends the mid-range free kick miles over the bar. Strong but inaccurate shot.
84' Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Daniele Chiffi blows his whistle for a foul.
83' That's a clear yellow card. Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) goes into the book.
82' Substitution. Jesper Karlsson (Lecce) replaces Tete Morente.
82' Substitution. Ylber Ramadani (Lecce) has come on for Balthazar Pierret.
80' We are about to witness a subsitution. Liam Henderson (Empoli) for Alberto Grassi.
80' Here is a change. Giuseppe Pezzella is going off and Roberto D'Aversa gives the last tactical orders to Junior Sambia (Empoli).
76' Patrick Dorgu (Lecce) takes the chance to have an effort at goal from inside the box but misses to the right of the target.
76' Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) has a shot blocked from inside the box.
75' Here comes a substitution. Jacopo Fazzini (Empoli) is brought on as a substitute for Youssef Maleh.
73' Tete Morente (Lecce) creates himself some space on the edge of the box and unleashes a strong shot which is blocked by a defender.
72' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 12:9.
70' Youssef Maleh (Empoli) makes a strong challenge and Daniele Chiffi blows for a foul.
69' Sebastiano Esposito (Empoli) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his strike wasn't accurate at all and the ball went well over the bar.
68' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Santiago Pierotti as he is replaced by Kevin Bonifazi (Lecce).
67' Daniele Chiffi blows his whistle. Mohamed Kaba (Lecce) commits a foul after dangerous play.
66' Sebastiano Esposito (Empoli) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.
63' Lorenzo Colombo (Empoli) finds space inside the box but rifles his effort miles over the bar.
63' Sebastiano Esposito (Empoli) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.
61' The linesman makes the right call and Empoli will have a corner.
58' Balthazar Pierret (Lecce) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
57' Great save! Liberato Cacace (Empoli) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot towards the bottom left corner was brilliantly saved by Wladimiro Falcone.
56' An attempted cross from Lorenzo Colombo (Empoli) is cleared.
55' Alberto Grassi (Empoli) wins the ball from the corner and heads at goal from near the penalty spot, but it's a soft effort and drifts well past the left post.
55' Sebastiano Esposito (Empoli) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
52' Substitution. Thorir Johann Helgason did his best and is replaced by Mohamed Kaba (Lecce).
52' Emmanuel Gyasi (Empoli) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
50' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 7:9.
47' 1 - 2 GOAL! Liberato Cacace (Empoli) scores with a header from close range after Emmanuel Gyasi headed a pin-point lofted cross into his path. It's 1:2.
46' Alberto Grassi (Empoli) is penalised for holding. Daniele Chiffi signals a set piece.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+4' The end of the first half.
45+3' Santiago Pierotti (Lecce) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
45+1' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Giuseppe Pezzella (Empoli).
45' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.
44' Mattia De Sciglio (Empoli) brings his opponent down. Daniele Chiffi has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul.
44' Empoli can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
43' Lassana Coulibaly (Lecce) commits a rough foul. Daniele Chiffi stops the game and makes a call.
41' Flag up against Nikola Krstovic (Lecce). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
40' Tete Morente (Lecce) bangs the ball towards goal from the edge of the box, but it's rising all the way and sails high over the bar.
38' The ball falls kindly for Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) inside the box, but it's a poor effort and flies well wide of the right post.
38' Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) finds himself free inside the box and pulls the trigger, but his effort is brilliantly stopped by one of the defending players.
37' Tete Morente (Lecce) receives a yellow card.
37' The foul by Tete Morente (Lecce) was seen by Daniele Chiffi who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
34' Alberto Grassi (Empoli) lets fly with a crisp shot from inside the box after picking up a lofted pass from Sebastiano Esposito, but the ball goes a whisker wide of the left post.
32' Sebastiano Esposito (Empoli) whips in a cross from the corner, but Wladimiro Falcone is well positioned and punches the ball away.
31' Sebastiano Esposito (Empoli) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.
29' Daniele Chiffi has a clear sight and sees a foul from Lassana Coulibaly (Lecce).
28' Total attempts – 1:5.
24' The game is interrupted. Balthazar Pierret (Lecce) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
22' Federico Baschirotto (Lecce) was too forceful with his tackle and Daniele Chiffi interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
21' The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Lecce.
21' Mattia De Sciglio comes onto the pitch after Ardian Ismajli (Empoli) signals to the bench that he cannot continue any longer after picking up an injury.
20' The game is interrupted now, Ardian Ismajli (Empoli) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.

19' Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) had a good chance to change the score. He ran towards the goal and unleashed a low shot from just outside the penalty area which went towards the middle of the net, but the goalkeeper was ready and made an amazing save.
16' Santiago Pierotti (Lecce) makes a rough challenge and Daniele Chiffi blows his whistle for a foul.
15' The resulting corner, taken by Thorir Johann Helgason (Lecce), comes to nothing.

15' Thorir Johann Helgason (Lecce) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and smashes a glorious looking effort towards the bottom right corner, but Jacopo Seghetti thwarts him with a great two-handed save.

14' Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) sets himself up and has a crack at goal from the edge of the box. The shot heads low to the middle of the goal, but Jacopo Seghetti tracks it all the way and makes an easy save.
13' The number of shots on goal at present is 1:2.
11' 0 - 2 GOAL! Tete Morente launches a long throw into the box which evades everyone except Nikola Krstovic (Lecce), who gleefully thumps the ball into the net from close range. That makes it 0:2.
10' Flag goes up against Emmanuel Gyasi (Empoli) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.

9' That didn't go as planned! Lorenzo Colombo (Empoli) tried his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort low towards the middle of the goal was too weak to get past Wladimiro Falcone, who easily kept it out.
9' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Sebastiano Esposito (Empoli).
8' Frederic Guilbert (Lecce) tackles a bit over-zealously and Daniele Chiffi blows for a foul.
7' Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) is caught offside!
6' 0 - 1 Goal! Tete Morente (Lecce) picks up the ball inside the box, finds himself in a good position and fires in a shot which is deflected past Jacopo Seghetti. He makes it 0:1.
5' Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
4' Daniele Chiffi blows the whistle, Youssef Maleh (Empoli) is penalised for a foul.
3' Thorir Johann Helgason (Lecce) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
1' The match has just started.
The players are on the pitch and Lecce will have the kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Daniele Chiffi.
